long_description: Giveffect provides a powerful all-in-one software platform exclusively for nonprofits. We offer fundraising, events, online donations, volunteer management, donor management, marketing, constituent relationship management software, and more. We are well positioned for rapid expansion in the coming years and have garnered top industry recognition for our platform.
name: Giveffect
one_liner: Fundraising, Volunteer and Donor Management SaaS for nonprofits.
